correctness.rationale: All 2^(n-1) sign corners are actual vertices because tree incidence columns are linearly independent. A bipartite gauge makes every 2c_v X_v an incident fair-spin sum. Subtree conditioning proves that expectation of a product of arbitrary even local test functions factors, despite shared edges; hence the magnitudes are mutually independent. Binomial-square convolution gives F_T(z)=2^{-(n-1)} product_v sum_j binom(d_v,j)z^((d_v-2j)^2). Direct sign enumeration independently checked joint magnitude distributions for a six-vertex path, a seven-vertex star and a branched seven-vertex tree. The mean, variance, extremal shell multiplicities, path/star variance rigidity, bounded-degree triangular-array CLT and star centered-chi-square limit follow from this factorization and standard inequalities. Counts are finite diagnostics, not proofs for every tree.
